title: Home practical guide and safety card: cress phototropism box
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
unit: Spring 2: Transport, the periodic table and waves
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 111 (Home practical guide and safety card: cress phototropism box (portal worksheet; adult cuts the box))
intro: Lesson 111: Plant responses: tropisms and auxin. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To show plants grow towards light (phototropism)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult cuts a hole in one end of the box
Put the seedlings at the other end
Close the lid so light only enters through the hole
Open briefly each day to water and observe

questions.q: Big question: how does the seedling move without muscles?
questions.a: Auxin makes the shaded side grow faster, bending it towards light.
